title: Carrier Program Price Write-Down on Mold Remediation Jobs
content:
On an Insurance Claim Services arrangement that writes off carrier program price adjustments, the program difference on a Mold Remediation job is never billed to the customer.

**Program write-down.** When the claim file carries no program price adjustment write-off yet, the program write-down is the program pricing discount percentage of the mold-covered total, rounded to the cent, half up; when it carries program price adjustment write-offs, the program write-down is their total times the fraction of the mold-covered total over the claim file's estimate amount, the fraction never taken above 1, rounded to the cent, half up, and their whole total when the estimate amount is 0.00; on every other arrangement there is no program write-down.

The mold-covered total is the job's remediation scope, equipment day and clearance fee lines as booked. The program pricing discount percentage is the one the claim file's billing arrangement carries.

| Arrangement writes off program price adjustments | Program price adjustment write-offs on the claim file | Program write-down |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | None yet | The arrangement's program pricing discount percentage of the mold-covered total, rounded to the cent, half up |
| Yes | Some, estimate amount above 0.00 | Their total times the mold-covered total over the estimate amount (at most 1), rounded to the cent, half up |
| Yes | Some, estimate amount 0.00 | Their whole total |
| No | — | None |

Hypothetical figures: with no write-off yet, a discount percentage of 4 and a mold-covered total of 7350.00, the write-down is 294.00. With write-offs of 520.00, an estimate amount of 16000.00 and a mold-covered total of 4000.00, the fraction is 0.25 and the write-down is 130.00.
